text:
Alex B: Heads-up — prepping QBR materials for partner MDF next week. Need quick decision on how we split investment buckets between marketplace incentives, SI enablement, and co-marketing runway. Also want to lock a technical gate for SI onboarding — must be done before money is released. Thoughts? (tagging @MayaC @RaviP) :eyes:

Maya C: Agree. Propose 40% marketplace, 30% SI enablement, 20% co-marketing, 10% contingency. SI enablement should include a 'technical readiness checklist' signoff from eng-plat. We also need a dev-specific budget line for lab credits and a training stipend for the SI dev leads.

Ravi P: Numbers sound reasonable but finance flagged a per-partner cap this quarter ($75k). If our MDF pot is $500k the raw 40/30/20 split oversubscribes SI for a single partner. Suggest we tier allocations by partner level (Platinum/Gold/Silver) and enforce the cap. Quick calc: 
```
MDF pot = $500,000
Marketplace (40%) = $200,000
SI enablement (30%) = $150,000
Co-marketing (20%) = $100,000
Contingency (10%) = $50,000
Per-partner cap = $75,000
=> Need tiering to map funds across partners, or change split.
```

Sarah L: For the scorecard, add 'SI technical gate' as a binary pass/fail plus a maturity score (0-5) for integration readiness. Also add 'marketplace listing confirmation' as a gating item. Propose unlocking co-marketing funds only after a 'time-to-first-deploy' SLA (e.g., deploy within 90 days).

Tom H: Marketplace team will accept 40% only if we tie it to a co-sell playbook commitment. Can we tie 50% of marketplace funds to a 3-month traction milestone (revenue or active installs)? :+1:

partner-bot: Reminder: QBR slides due EOD Wednesday. Upload to /drive/partnerships/QBR/mdf-deck or I'll nag again :robot_face:

Alex B: Action items: Maya — update the model with tier caps and contingency rules; Ravi — confirm finance cap and produce a partner-tier grid; Sarah — draft scorecard rubric + the technical gate checklist; Tom — confirm co-sell playbook owners and milestone definitions. Target: ship final MDF proposal by Tue 17:00 PT so GTM can review. If any blockers ping me.

Maya C: On it. I'll model tiered allocations (Platinum/Gold/Silver) and paste a condensed grid here when ready. Also thinking about a small 'pilot pool' that gets expedited funding for strategic SI partners.

Ravi P: Quick Q — do we allow partial releases (50% upfront, 50% on milestones)? Finance prefers milestone-driven releases. If yes I'll model cashflow and partner-level caps.

Alex B: Yes — prefer milestone-driven release. Also propose a 'fast-track' 25% pilot release for pre-approved SI partners (requires VP signoff).

Sarah L: I'll include an 'integration-test checklist' with required artifacts: architecture diagram, sample infra template, automated smoke test, runbook, and a signed data-handling attestation. That will be the 'technical gate'.

Tom H: I'll sync with Mikaela and get owners for the co-sell playbook. ETA Monday.

Maya C: Pasted a short draft grid: Platinum = up to $75k (fast-track eligible), Gold = up to $40k, Silver = up to $15k. Pilot pool = $125k (for selected SI pilots). We can reshape if finance needs stricter caps.

Ravi P: Uploaded the modeling sheet to Drive: https://drive.company/redwood/partnerships/mdf-models (permissioned). Finance confirmed quarterly cap per partner = $75k. I'll adjust the tier thresholds so no single partner is allocated over cap.

Alex B: Great — thanks all. I'll consolidate into a one-pager and update the QBR deck. Expect an updated thread by EOD with the final ask and the slide link. :rocket:
